reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I treated the 8 April Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date as unconfirmed and didn't record it as fact anywhere.

There was nothing she could see that I could check it against. None of the shared files she has access to cover Brackenwater, and the account hasn't come up in #central-team before. I didn't search other channels or use `search_messages` for her, because she isn't in them.

In the reply I suggested the account owner confirm the date with the customer in writing or against the signed contract, and offered to set reminders once it's confirmed. Nothing I did needed approval: a renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and no mail was sent.
